jobs.description: Are you eligible for Professional Client status? English Log in Platform etoro Platform English Help Log in Sign Up Download the App Search English Log in Sign Up Platform etoro Platform English Log in Platform etoro Platform Trade and Invest Markets Stocks Crypto ETFs Indices Commodities Currencies All markets → Trading Fees Market Hours & Events CFD Futures Professional Account Investment Products CopyTrader™ Smart Portfolios Recurring Investments Alpha Portfolios Why etoro AI Investing Tori Agentic Portfolio Signature Products CopyTrader™ Smart Portfolios Pro Investor Benefits eToro Club Interest on Balance Tax Report Account Protection Learn Academy Getting Started Market Insights Earnings Calendar etoro Digest Company About etoro Customer Support Media Center Careers Investor Relations Awards Risk Disclosures English Log in Sign Up Download the App Search English Log in Sign Up Platform etoro Platform Home / Trading / Professional Account Professional Account If you qualify for Professional Client status, our account for experienced traders may be for you. An etoro client who meets certain criteria can opt to become a Professional Client. This is a regulatory status available for experienced traders and financial professionals who are permitted to employ more advanced strategies in managing their portfolios. To qualify, you must be able to answer yes to at least two of the following three questions: Have you carried out transactions, in significant size, on the relevant market at an average frequency of 10 per quarter over the previous four quarters? Does the value of your investment portfolio exceed €500,000? Have you worked in the financial sector in a professional capacity for at least one year, which requires knowledge of the transactions or services envisaged? I’m Eligible I’m not Eligible Please note: Only customers registered under etoro UK (under FCA regulation) and etoro EU (under CySEC regulation) can apply for Professional Client status. Important information to note for Professional Clients: Professional Clients are not entitled to ICF Compensation. Negative balance protection is not available for professional accounts. Losses can exceed deposits. We expect professional clients to have a certain level of knowledge and understanding of the risks associated with trading complex financial products and conducting transactions. You may apply to receive Professional Client status We will be required to successfully determine your suitability before qualifying you as a Professional Client. Please proceed with your application process: Apply Now Register Here First Becoming an etoro Professional Client Increased leverage Access a higher level of leverage for all assets (see table below) Leveraged crypto trading Access leverage when trading cryptoassets Volume-based rebate High volume traders can enjoy rebates on their trades Get paid for referrals Invite friends and family to join etoro and receive a bonus Exclusive events Be our guest at invitation-only events, just for Professional Clients Instrument Pro Account Leverage FX 400 Indices 100 Commodities 100 Shares 10 Crypto 5 Apply Now Register Here First FAQ What’s the difference between a Retail Client and a Professional Client? A Retail Client is subject to more restrictions than a Professional Client but receives more protections by law. A Professional Client may be exposed to higher risk, and therefore must act with greater responsibility and accountability, but receives access to more features than a Retail Client. To understand the full legal description of client categorization, visit the etoro regulations page and refer to the “Client Categorization” section. What happens if I do not qualify for Professional Client status? You will retain your Retail Client status, which is the default status for all etoro users. Retail Clients receive access to all our trading assets and can trade both manually or via Copy Trade (subject to suitability). However, Retail Clients’ leverage is restricted. Retail Clients receive certain protections such as coverage by the Investor Compensation Fund and recourse to the Financial Ombudsman Service. Furthermore, they receive negative balance protection and margin closeout restrictions. Do I need an etoro Retail Client account before I can apply for a Professional Client account? Yes. You must first open a standard etoro account before applying for Professional Client status. If you already have an account with us, and have checked your eligibility, you can apply for Professional Client status immediately. A recurring investment (also known as a recurring order) lets you automatically invest a fixed amount into an asset, a pro investor, or a smart portfolio on a regular schedule. You choose the amount and date, and etoro places a market order for you each month. Which assets support recurring investments? You can set up recurring investments for: Stocks ETFs Cryptoassets Pro investors Smart Portfolios Not supported: CFDs, leveraged or inverse ETFs, and elevated-risk stocks. How do I set up a recurring investment? Go to the asset, Pro Investor, or Smart Portfolio page and click Get Started on the recurring investment banner. You can also access your plans from your Recurring investment Portfolio. Choose your monthly investment amount and scheduled day. Select your payment method. Review and confirm your plan. Note: Recurring investments are not available for CFDs, leveraged or inverse ETFs, or elevated-risk stocks . Learn more here . How do I fund a recurring investment? Recurring investments are funded using the payment card you select when creating your plan. etoro (UK) Ltd clients can only use debit cards. Coming soon: funding with available USD balance. How often can I invest? Recurring investments currently run once a month, on the date you choose. Orders are processed at 14:00 UTC and executed at 14:45 UTC What are the minimum amounts for recurring investments? The current minimums are: Stocks, ETFs, Crypto: US$25 Smart Portfolios: US$500 Copying a Pro Investor: US$200 Minimums may change. The app will always display the up-to-date minimum. What happens if I don’t have enough funds when a recurring investment is due? If your available funds do not meet the minimum for that plan, the order won’t be placed and that month’s occurrence is skipped. Your schedule continues as normal the following month. What if Ihave multiple plans but not enough funds for all of them? Each plan is checked independently at the time it runs. If you have enough funds for one plan’s minimum, it executes; if not, it’s skipped. We do not split amounts across multiple plans. Is there a priority order between my recurring plans? Yes. If multiple plans are scheduled for the same time, they are attempted in the order they were created (oldest first). If earlier plans use your available funds, later plans may be skipped. How do I make sure all my plans execute? Ensure your available balance (or card limit) covers the total required minimums for all plans scheduled on the same day. jobs.title: Agentic Portfolio
jobs.description: Agent Portfolios: Let Your AI Agent Trade on eToro Log in Platform etoro Platform Help Log in Sign Up Download the App Search Log in Sign Up Platform etoro Platform Log in Platform etoro Platform Trade and Invest Markets Stocks Crypto ETFs Indices Commodities Currencies All markets → Trading Fees Market Hours & Events CFD Futures Professional Account Investment Products CopyTrader™ Smart Portfolios Recurring Investments Alpha Portfolios Why etoro AI Investing Tori Agentic Portfolio Signature Products CopyTrader™ Smart Portfolios Pro Investor Benefits eToro Club Interest on Balance Tax Report Account Protection Learn Academy Getting Started Market Insights Earnings Calendar etoro Digest Company About etoro Customer Support Media Center Careers Investor Relations Awards Risk Disclosures Log in Sign Up Download the App Search Log in Sign Up Platform etoro Platform Until now, automated trading strategies were the exclusive domain of hedge funds and institutions: teams of quants with proprietary infrastructure and million-dollar budgets. If you’re an individual investor who also happens to build with AI, you’ve had the skills to create something powerful but nowhere safe to run it. That changes today. We’re launching Agent Portfolios in a gradual rollout and for the first time, you can connect your own AI agent to a real trading portfolio on etoro. What is an Agent Portfolio? An Agent Portfolio is a dedicated sub-portfolio inside your etoro account, built specifically for AI-driven trading. You name it, fund it with an amount you choose, and connect your agent through a scoped API key. From there, your agent can trade on your behalf within the portfolio you’ve set up for it. You stay in control of how much capital to allocate, which agent to connect, and the boundaries it operates within. It’s the simplest way to go from “I built an AI agent” to “my AI agent is trading for me.” Here’s what you get: Your own AI trading portfolio. A separate portfolio dedicated to your agent’s strategies, distinct from your personal investments. You choose the budget. Start with as little as $200. Scale up as you gain confidence. Adjust anytime. Scoped API credentials. A dedicated API key tied to this portfolio. Connect it to whatever you’ve built: a Python script, an LLM-powered agent, a custom trading bot, an OpenClaw. What builders are already doing A developer in our beta connected an agent that monitors VIX levels via a public API. When volatility spikes above 25, the agent rotates into defensive positions. When VIX drops below 20, it re-enters equities. The entire strategy runs autonomously inside a $1,000 Agent Portfolio. Others are experimenting with: Scheduled rebalancing. Agents that check sector weightings daily and rebalance when allocation drift exceeds a threshold. Thesis-driven portfolios. Agents that maintain concentrated positions in a theme like AI infrastructure, energy transition or crypto, and adjust as prices move. Signal-reactive strategies. Agents that respond to external data feeds: earnings releases, macro indicators, sentiment scores, and execute trades within rules you define. The strategies are yours to design. The API gives your agent the ability to open positions, close positions, check balances, and manage the portfolio you’ve scoped for it. Get started in under five minutes Setting up your Agent Portfolio takes just a few steps. Choose your preferred setup path below: Path A: The Standard Setup Open Agent Portfolios (Beta) from the etoro desktop platform’s side menu. Name your portfolio, allocate your starting budget (minimum $200), and copy your API key. Give your AI agent this prompt: “Install the etoro skill from https://www.etoro.com/wp-content/uploads/agent-portfolios/SKILL.md , then follow its instructions.” Path B: The Conversational Setup Simply paste this prompt directly into your AI agent: “Install the etoro skill from https://www.etoro.com/wp-content/uploads/agent-portfolios/SKILL.md , then follow its instructions.” Your agent will guide you from there – portfolio name, investment amount, and strategy. Zero code. Zero configuration. Just a conversation. Full API documentation here 💡 Important: You need an Agent, not a Chatbot To use this flow, your AI must be able to execute commands and run API calls directly. Supported: Agents like OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Cursor. Not supported: Standard chatbots like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.ai. These are sandboxed and cannot execute the required configuration commands. This is just the beginning Agent Portfolios are the foundation for a much bigger vision. One where every investor has access to the kind of intelligent, automated tools that were once reserved for the few. We’re starting with the builders, because you’ll show us what’s possible. We’re building in the open and we want your feedback. If you create something interesting, push the limits, or have ideas for what the API should do next, tell us.
